fieldDescription: Allow new departures. Existing trips continue when disabled.
Maximum active Living Sector trips. Lowering this does not delete existing fleets.
How often to consider new departures. Longer intervals reduce scanning and maximum traffic throughput.
How often to check safety and cleanup. Longer intervals delay responses to war or lost ports.
Allow new passenger and charter trips. Existing trips continue when disabled.
Include inhabited stations alongside planets.
Smallest eligible inhabited market.
One shared departure probability before crowding and cooldowns. Not a separate allowance per type.
Maximum active civilian trips including existing VIPs. Lowering this does not delete fleets.
Minimum time between civilian departures from the same port across all types.
Small passenger fleets travelling within a system.
Larger passenger fleets travelling between systems.
Small irregular trips within or between systems.
Chance a new shuttle unloads and returns to its origin. Otherwise it finishes at its destination.
Chance a new liner unloads and returns to its origin.
Chance a new charter unloads and returns to its origin.
Chance to try the operator's passenger ship roster before Independents. An empty pool falls back to the other.
Relative chance to propose a shuttle when a departure is possible. Zero disables proposals.
Relative chance to propose a liner. Types without a valid route yield to the others.
Relative chance to propose a charter.
Reduces departure probability as traffic increases. This is not a population quota.
Number of eligible planets and stations per extra target fleet.
Upper bound before random target variation.
Random proportional variation. 0.25 means up to 25 percent above or below the base target.
How often to reroll the shared crowding target.
Log basic automatic spawns and diversions to starsector.log. Independent of the rotating traffic recorder.
Optional long-run event recorder. Buffered JSONL files rotate across all saves. Off disables collection and writes.
Shared allowance for all recorder runs. Oldest files rotate out. A reduction while off applies when recording next starts.
